title: Meta Raises Muse Ad Budget to 39% After Rare US Start

tickers.name: Meta Platforms, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
The company has shifted how it allocates marketing funds for its newest product to drive global adoption. Meta now directs 39% of its total advertising spend toward the Muse AI agent, up from 23% in September, based on data via Sensor Tower. This spending surge follows a launch in which Muse hit 10.2 million downloads in the U.S. within 40 days, outpacing the 3.7 million downloads OpenAI's ChatGPT recorded during its first 40 days. Muse currently ranks as the most downloaded app on Google Play and No. 3 in the U.S. App Store.

Muse's 14 day retention rate is 23%, exceeding the 16% average of rivals including Claude and Grok. Daily active users for the agent hit 2.5 million on October 16, a 15% increase over the prior week, although this total represents less than 25% of its U.S. download base. The AI companion has not yet been released to users in Europe.

Meta’s AI agent Muse reached 10.2M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a pace only 11 other apps have matched in history.

Most of those were mobile games.

Its U.S. users stick around better than average, with 30% returning after 7 days and 23% after 14, against rival averages of 19% and 16%.

Daily active users hit 2.5M on October 16, up 15% in a week but still under a quarter of U.S. downloads.
